title: Sober default theme, surface engine, layout primitives, unified layers

entries.selector: default theme (glass, mesh, glow, 10px controls, 700 headings)
entries.note: The default is solid and neutral. To keep the old look use `designStyle("liquid")` or set defaultStyle "glass", paper "mesh", radius 1, iconStroke 2 and heading weight 700. Apps that override `--ca-*` tokens are unaffected; apps that read `--ca-radius-*` or the shadow tokens get the new values.

entries.replacement: <Grid columns={n} gap="4"> (1-12 or responsive); grid-template-columns in a class
entries.note: `cols` becomes `columns`. `rowGap`, `colGap` and CSS template strings (`2fr 1fr`) are gone and are reported for you to write in a class.
`gap` is a spacing step string, not pixels: an untouched `gap={16}` would silently become step 16. Static values on the scale are converted; dynamic or off-scale ones are reported.

Deprecated in 3.0.0 (dev warning) and kept as a wrapper. `thickness` maps to `elevation` (thin 2, regular 3, thick 4); the default regular is written as elevation 3 so the fill, blur and rim stay. Dynamic props are left with their import.
`refraction` maps to material liquid (true) or glass (false).
`Row` used to default to flex-start alignment; `Flex` leaves it to the browser (stretch), so a Row without `align` may need `align="start"`.

entries.replacement: .ca-floating on the layer element itself; the top layer orders overlays
entries.note: Overlays live in the top layer, so stacking no longer depends on z-index. The wrapper div is gone and `.ca-date__float` was removed; the z tokens remain for your own in-flow UI.
